back.es: el maestro: teacher (especially a primary-school teacher); also master or expert
back.example: My third-grade teacher (female) was very good.

note: The example uses the feminine form maestra, which is correct and natural; the editor could use "Mi maestro de tercer grado era muy bueno." if the example should show the exact headword, and the hint could say "primary-school teacher" to be more precise.
